notes.note: Rows 202-259 are not referenced by Quest021.bla (script ends at +130 -> row 131; the pck holds the same script): unused Pigmon-report version of 'Backing Up Altron', as quest_024 found. 202-204 end the 190-204 block from quest_024 (slots 12-14), same English as its identical rows.

Leader-variant slots inferred from wording, same slot pattern as quest_024's blocks (slot 0 Wing Zero, slots 5/11 polite, slot 7 rough Momotaros): 207-221 = slots 0-14 (207/208 the curt Wing Zero / 00 version, 214 slot 7 rough), 223-237 (228/234 polite 'boku', 230 rough), 239-253 (244/250 polite, 246 rough). Identical Japanese kept identical.
Unused scene: Altron (Wufei) rebuking the heroes for interfering; 238, 254, 255, 259 also Altron. 'Jibun no seigi' / 'onore no seigi' rendered 'your own (sense of) justice' (Wufei's justice theme).
Altron's creed, worded to match quest_024 (row 117 'The righteous have to be strong', row 125 'We are in the right'). 'Uketore' = handing over the Altron Shield (row 257).
'Altron Shield' is not in the item tables (unused reward); named after the existing Shenlong Shield / Gundam Shield pattern. Format as 'Obtained "Moto Crystal".'
Quest board text; QuestMess 0.73 has a longer version ('Shadow Moon has sent RX a challenge...'); same opening reused.

Quest022.bla maps TextIdOffset+N to row N+1 (checked: +4 Shadow Moon = 5, +5 RX = 6, +11 RX = 12 with 11 empty, +13..+17 Shadow Moon = 14-18, +19 RX = 20, +21..+23 narration after CharaNameOut = 22-24, OkWinIn +27/+28 = 28/29). +29 at the party check points at empty row 30.
RX's finisher uses the unified skill name 'Revolcrash' (system_081, name_fix.py).
'Crisis' = the Crisis Empire, kept short as in the source.
22-23 are one narration sentence split across two rows (BLACK RX opening-style narration); 23 continues 22. 24 echoes quest_017's 'Don't lose! Kamen Rider Black RX!'.
Moto Crystal: item name from ItemNameFormal / QuestMess 0.523.
Quest title from QuestMess 0.23 'The Shadow Prince Returns!'.
'Hidane' rendered 'ember' as in the main story (MainEventMess0403/0463); QuestMess 0.74 has 'spark of the Plasma Spark'. This board text says top floor, QuestMess says Layer 4; translated as written.
Quest023.bla maps +N to row N+1: +3 Alien Guts = 4, +4 Mebius = 5, +5 Alien Nackle = 6, +6 Jack then Ace (both call +6) = 7, +8 Mebius = 9.
Mebius; dropped subject of 'shitte iru' restored as 'we' (he came with the party).
Not referenced by the script (Ace's call reuses +6 -> row 7 instead of +7). Evidently Ace's (or Jack's) apology to Mebius for being beaten; translated as the brothers' line.
